usedFor: Woodpecker runs your outreach, and HubSpot records interest through “Add Notes to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Prospect Interested” in Woodpecker, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A prospect marked interested leaves a note on the HubSpot contact, so sales sees it.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so make sure Woodpecker passes one.
